WITH first_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as baseline1
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
above_baseline1 AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_rate, fb.baseline1
  FROM telescope_avgs ta
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline fb
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse_rate > fb.baseline1
),
second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as baseline2
  FROM above_baseline1
),
above_baseline2 AS (
  SELECT ab1.telescref, ab1.avg_pulse_rate, ab1.baseline1, sb.baseline2
  FROM above_baseline1 ab1
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline sb
  WHERE ab1.avg_pulse_rate > sb.baseline2
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_of_averages,
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate - baseline1) as mean_excess_over_baseline1,
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate - baseline2) as mean_excess_over_baseline2
FROM above_baseline2

assumptions.assumption: "Missing values" refers to NULL entries in the pulsepersec column.
